items.title: Mike Ditka dies at 86
items.summary: Mike Ditka, the Hall of Fame tight end who coached the 1985 Bears to a Super Bowl title, died at 86, his family announced. Adam Schefter's post got 81K likes, the NFL's 47K, and Barack Obama's tribute ("When I got to Chicago in the summer of 1985, Mike Ditka and the Chicago Bears were king") 46K. The same day, the Nobel Peace Prize went to Navi Pillay, who joked "If you clap a little bit more, I may share this prize with Trump."
items.author: @AdamSchefter

post.name: Adam Schefter
post.text: NFL legend Mike Ditka, who revolutionized the tight end position before becoming the head coach of the world champion 1985 Bears and a towering figure in the city of Chicago, has passed away, his family announced. He was 86.
